_about: Every spoken line in the Linguae intro. {la:word|gloss} marks a word spoken in another language (la, es, fr-fr, de); the gloss is shown on hover in the captions. tools/voices.py turns this into audio/*.mp3 and js/voice.js.

open.ahem: Ahem. My cousins. They get a little excited.
intro.1: Welcome to {la:Linguae|languages}! That's Latin for languages.
intro.2: Here, you practice a language the way you'll actually use it: one whole sentence at a time.
intro.3: Every language gets its own site, and every site gets its own tutor.
intro.8: And you only need one account. Make it once, and it works on every site.
ask.lang: So, which language are you learning?
hand.la: Latin? {la:Optimē!|Excellent!} That's my specialty. Let me show you around Verba.
hand.es: Spanish? Then you want my cousin. {es:Felicísimo}!
la.1: Verba is where you practice Latin, from Latin One Honors all the way to AP Latin.
la.2: Start by picking your topics. They're sorted by class, and the ones you've already covered in class are shaded. Press Focus on a topic to practice it in every sentence.
la.3: Then I build you a brand-new sentence, and you translate the whole thing: English to Latin, or Latin to English.
la.4: I check your answer and show you exactly what went wrong. Word order that doesn't change the meaning never counts against you, and a missing macron still counts, unless it changes the word.
la.5: After a translation, name why one word is used for extra credit. There's a whole mode for that, too.
la.6: Stuck? Ask me anything. Before you answer, I won't give it away. After you answer, ask whatever you like.
la.7: To power me, you'll need a free AI key. The site's guide walks you through getting one in a couple of minutes.
la.8: Ending charts and vocabulary sit right above every sentence, and you can hide them whenever you want.
la.9: Every right answer earns XP. Climb from {la:Discipulus|student} to {la:Imperātor|emperor}, keep your daily streak going, and finish AP Latin to earn the {la:Laurea|laurel crown}.
la.10: Make an account to keep your progress on any device and to join the leaderboard. No email needed. Just keep your account key somewhere safe, because a forgotten password can't be recovered.
ask.la: Ready? Shall we head to Verba?

es.3: Then I build you a brand-new sentence, and you translate the whole thing: English to Spanish, or Spanish to English.
es.4: I check your answer and show you exactly what went wrong. A missing accent still counts, unless it changes the word, like {es:hablo|I speak} and {es:habló|he spoke}.
es.5: After a translation, name why one word is used for extra credit: {es:ser|to be} or {es:estar|to be}, {es:por|for} or {es:para|for}, preterite or imperfect.
es.6: Stuck? Ask me anything. Before you answer, I won't give it away. After you answer, ask whatever you like.
es.7: To power me, you'll need a free AI key. The site's guide walks you through getting one in a couple of minutes.
es.8: Charts and vocabulary sit right above every sentence. And {es:vosotros|you all}? Totally optional.
es.9: Every right answer earns XP. Climb from {es:Estudiante|student} to {es:Leyenda|legend}, keep your daily streak going, and finish AP Spanish to earn the {es:Corona|crown}.
es.10: Your account is the same one you use everywhere else. Your Spanish progress just gets its own place in it. No email needed, but keep your account key safe.
